- workflow-templates/.claude/scripts/edit_comment.py:154-171 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A same-uid process can replace a parent directory with a symlink between the scratchpad path validation and `os.open`; because `O_NOFOLLOW` protects only the final component, the open can reach a different caller-owned file that passes the subsequent `fstat` checks and has its contents published as a comment.
  WHY: MAJOR was reported by minimax and openai, while deepseek and qwen rated this NIT and described the same-uid race as impractical or a separate, pre-existing attack vector; using the highest reported severity, the race can bypass the path identity check and publish another file's contents.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
